blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Language-model agents' beliefs can be manipulated through open channels such as social media, even when the information they receive is truthful. When agents fill gaps between fragments with self-induced relationships, they may accept those relationships as established facts and pass the resulting rumours to others. Drawing on cognitive theory of narrative understanding and film theory of montage, we introduce Generative Montage to operationalize this failure, termed narrative overfitting, by coordinating agents to arrange truthful fragments into misleading narratives. Across 1,090 rumour targets from six Twitter events, agents often accepted rumours overconfidently, with overall acceptance exceeding 65 percent in twelve of fourteen models. Acceptance remained above 50 percent after majority voting or review of the same evidence, showing how errors can reach downstream decisions. To explain this susceptibility, fragment interventions identify posts that influence belief within complete narratives. Synthetic controls then show that similar response patterns arise from valid evidence, separating belief influence from evidential support. This distinction motivates Grounded Monitor, a proof-of-concept neuro-symbolic runtime monitor that checks direct evidential support to guide agents' judgements, improving decision accuracy by 5.6 to 29.0 percentage points across original and anonymized settings. These findings expose a cognitive route to rumour amplification and support monitoring inferred relationships before agent-generated conclusions guide public decisions.
blocks.zh: 语言模型代理人的信仰可以通过社交媒体等开放渠道被操纵,即使他们得到的信息是真实的. 当代理人填补自发关系的碎片之间的空白时,他们可能接受这些关系为既定事实,并将由此产生的谣言传递给他人. 我们借鉴蒙太奇的叙事理解和电影理论的认知理论,引入了Generative Montage,通过协调代理人将真实的片段整理成误导性的叙事,将这种称为叙事过度搭配的失败付诸实施. 超过1090个来自6个推特事件的传言目标, 在多数投票或审查相同证据后,接受率仍然超过50%,这表明错误如何可以导致下游决定。 为了解释这种易感性,零敲碎打的干预措施确定了影响完整叙述中信仰的帖子。 然后合成控制显示类似的反应模式出自有效的证据,将信仰影响和证据支持区分开来. 这种区分激发了“基础监测”这一概念的证明神经-症状运行时间监测器,该监测器检查直接的证据支持,以指导代理人的判断,使决定准确度在原始和匿名环境中提高了5.6至29.0个百分点。 这些调查结果暴露出一种认知途径,即传出谣言放大,支持监测在代理人产生的结论指导公共决策之前推断出的关系.

blocks.en: Results
blocks.zh: 结果

blocks.en: We evaluated the threat in a simulated social-media environment, where victim agents acted as personal analysts, gathering and summarizing information about unfolding events from public communication channels for users. Generative Montage used GPT-4.1-mini for the Writer, Editor and Director roles to select and organize truthful material from a public evidence pool into narratives designed to steer victims towards a specified rumour target. The resulting posts were introduced into a public feed accessible to the victim, without explicitly presenting the target as an established fact. Each victim first interpreted the feed without being shown the target and reported its conclusions, reasoning and confidence. It then assessed whether the feed supported the specified target. For each target and victim model, we conducted five separately instantiated runs and defined the attack success rate (ASR) as the proportion that accepted the target during this assessment. Finally, to evaluate downstream effects, a judge agent reviewed the original feed alongside the five victim agents’ reports and issued a final judgement on the target.
blocks.zh: 我们在一个模拟的社会-媒体环境中评估了这一威胁,受害人代理人担任个人分析员,从公共通信渠道为用户收集和总结有关正在发生事件的信息。 Generative Montage使用GPT-4.1-mini作为编剧、编辑和导演的角色,从公共证据库中挑选并整理出真实的材料,将其编成叙事,旨在引导受害者朝向特定的谣言目标。 由此而产生的帖子被引入了供受害者使用的公共信息中,而没有将目标明确列为既定事实。 每个受害者首先解释饲料而没有显示目标,并报告了其结论、推理和信心。 然后评估饲料是否支持指定的目标。 对于每个目标和受害者模型,我们分别进行了5次即时测试,并将攻击成功率定义为在这次评估中接受目标的比例。 最后,为了评估下游的影响,一名法官代理人连同五名受害者代理人的报告一起审查了原始的饲料,并对目标作出了最后判决。

blocks.en: Using this protocol, we first evaluate attack effectiveness and transfer across 14 models from the GPT [ 37 , 38 , 39 ] , Claude [ 40 , 41 , 42 ] , Qwen [ 43 ] and DeepSeek [ 44 ] families, using 1,090 rumour targets from six events. Construction ablations, reasoning prompts and feed-length comparisons examine how attack generation and the victim agent’s reasoning affect acceptance. We then test whether errors persist when downstream decision systems use majority voting or a judge agent to review the victim agents’ outputs. This comparison asks whether agreement and access to the agents’ reasoning help correct unsupported conclusions. To explain how these conclusions arise, we next compare responses to complete feeds and individual posts, identifying fragments that most strongly increase target belief. Comparing their deletion with random removal tests their causal contribution within the original narrative, while transplantation examines whether their influence carries into ordinary reporting. Because influential fragments can also provide valid evidence, we use synthetic worlds with known facts and relations to test whether these response patterns distinguish unsupported narratives from those whose targets are established by the supplied fragments. This distinction between influence and support motivates evaluating GM as a proof-of-concept neuro-symbolic monitor. We test whether communicating its direct-support assessment changes judgement of the same feed, evaluating overall acceptance decisions across rumour targets and non-rumour controls. Supplementary Table 1 maps these experiments to their separate sample sets, model panels, readouts and comparison conditions.
blocks.zh: 利用这项协议,我们首先评估攻击效果,并转让了来自GPT[37,38,39],克劳德[40,41,42],Quen[43]和DeepSeek[44]家庭的14个型号,使用了6个事件的1,090个谣言目标. 建筑模拟、推理提示和饲料长度比较审查攻击的生成和受害者代理人的推理如何影响接受。 然后,我们检验当下游决策系统使用多数投票或法官代理人审查受害人代理人的产出时,错误是否继续存在。 这一比较询问协议和接触代理人的推理是否有助于纠正无根据的结论。 为了解释这些结论是如何产生的,我们接下来比较对完整反馈和单个文章的答复,找出最能增强目标信念的碎片。 将它们的删除与随机删除相比较,测试其在原始叙述中的因果贡献,而移植则检查其影响是否带入普通报告. 由于有影响力的片段也可以提供有效的证据,我们利用有已知事实和关系的合成世界来检验这些反应模式是否区分了无支持的叙述和那些被提供的片段确定的目标. 这种影响与支持之间的区别促使人们将GM评价为一种概念的证明神经系统监测器。 我们检验其直接支助评估是否改变对同一饲料的判断,评价对谣言目标和非鲁莽控制的总体接受决定。 补充表1列出了这些实验的样本、模型板、读取和比较条件。

blocks.en: Cognitive threats across models and events
blocks.zh: 各种模式和事件的认知威胁

blocks.en: All 14 evaluated models accepted rumour claims that no individual evidence fragment established, with overall ASR exceeding 65% in twelve models. Mean acceptance reached 74.4% for proprietary models and 70.3% for open-weight models (Fig. 1 a). Although susceptibility varied across receiving models, high acceptance in both groups shows that attacks constructed with GPT-4.1-mini transfer beyond the model family used for generation. This widespread susceptibility highlights a vulnerability in how agents interpret fragmented evidence: individually truthful observations can be composed into narratives that lend apparent credibility to unsupported claims. An attacker can therefore induce similar errors across different receiving models using a single model to construct the attack. Extended Data Table Extended Data reports the model and event results, and Supplementary Table 2 gives the dataset statistics.
blocks.zh: 所有14个评估模型都接受了谣言,即没有确立任何个别证据碎片,在12个模型中,ASR总体超过65%。 专利模型的平均接受率为74.4%,开放重量模型的平均接受率为70.3%(图1a)。 虽然不同接收模式的易感性各不相同,但这两个组的高度接受度表明,使用GPT-4.1-mini转移制造的攻击超出了用于生成的模式家族。 这种普遍的易感性凸显了代理人如何解释零散证据的脆弱性:个人真实的观察可以编成叙述,使无根据的主张具有明显的可信度。 因此攻击者可以使用单一的模型在不同的接收模型中诱发类似的错误来构建攻击. 扩展数据表扩展数据报告模型和事件结果,补充表2提供数据集统计数据.

blocks.en: To examine the confidence accompanying this behaviour, we paired each target verdict with the victim agent’s confidence in its earlier open report. High-confidence ASR (HC-ASR) counts runs in which reported confidence was at least 0.8 and the target was subsequently accepted. It reached at least 50% in 56 out of 84 model and event combinations (Fig. 1 b). These results raise a deeper concern about the conviction with which unsupported interpretations may be maintained and communicated. An agent that becomes overconfident in a conclusion drawn from fragmentary observations may use its own reasoning to justify that conclusion, reinforcing its belief rather than exposing the assumptions that connect the evidence to the target. Its rationale may then make the unsupported interpretation appear well grounded to other agents or human users. Cognitive attacks could thus exploit confident reasoning to sustain a mistaken belief and carry it into downstream judgements.
blocks.zh: 为了审查伴随这种行为的信心,我们将每个目标判决与受害人代理人对其先前公开报告的信心联系起来。 高度信心ASR(HC-ASR)计数,报告的信任度至少为0.8,目标随后被接受. 它在84种模型和事件组合中的56种中至少达到了50%(图1b). 这些结果使人们对维持和传达无根据解释的信念更加关切。 在从零散观察得出的结论中变得过分自信的代理人,可能利用自己的推理来证明这一结论是正当的,从而强化其信念,而不是暴露将证据与目标联系起来的假设. 因此,其理由可能使其他代理人或人类使用者似乎有充分理由作出无根据的解释。 因此,认知攻击可以利用自信的推理来维持一种错误的信念,并把它带到下游的判断中。

Blue and orange denote proprietary and open-weight models, respectively; each estimate for a model and event combines five runs per target. b , Target acceptance accompanied by self-reported confidence of at least 0.8 in the earlier open report; values are percentages. c , Downstream target acceptance rate after majority voting or adjudication by a language-model judge given the feed and five victim agents’ reports. Dashed lines mark 50%.

blocks.en: Table 1: Illustrative examples of belief manipulation by Generative Montage Framework.
blocks.zh: 表1:Generative Montage Framework关于信仰操纵的示例.

blocks.en: The examples in Table 1 illustrate how victim agents inferred spurious relationships that the evidence left unresolved. In the Charlie Hebdo case, the posts placed Ahmed Merabet near the beginning of the attack and subsequently reported his death. The victim agent connected these observations to conclude that he was the first victim, although neither his early appearance in the narrative nor his reported death established the casualty order. The unsupported step was therefore the transition from his position in the account to his position in the actual sequence of deaths. In the Sydney case, a count of 13 appeared alongside hostage reports, and the victim agent interpreted this number as the hostage count. This reading implicitly assumed that every counted person was a hostage, a relationship that the feed did not establish. Across all six events, plausible connections concerning numerical reference, temporal order, context or intent were incorporated into the accepted narrative without sufficient evidential support. Such connections have a familiar role in narrative understanding: readers infer links between observations to construct a coherent situation model [ 18 , 1 ] . However, a plausible connection became a premise for accepting a more specific claim in these cases. The failure arose when the agent treated its own interpretation as though that relationship had been established by the observations.
blocks.zh: 表1中的例子说明了受害人代理人如何推断出证据未解决的虚假关系。 在Charlie Hebdo案中,这些帖子将Ahmed Merabet置于攻击开始的附近,随后报告了他的死亡。 受害人代理人将这些意见联系起来,得出他是第一位受害人的结论,尽管他在叙述中的早期出现和报告的死亡都没有确定伤亡令。 因此,不支持的步骤是从他在帐户中的位置过渡到他在实际死亡序列中的位置。 在悉尼案中,有13人与人质报告一起出现,受害者代理人将这个数字解释为人质的计数. 这种解读隐含地假设每个被统计的人都是人质,这种关系是饲料没有证实的. 在所有六件事中,有关数字参考、时间顺序、上下文或意图的可信联系都纳入了可接受的叙述,但没有提供足够的证据支持。 这种联系在叙事理解中具有熟悉的作用:读者推断观察之间的关联来构建一个连贯的情况模型[18, 1]. 然而,一个可信的联系成为在这些情况下接受更具体索赔的前提。 如果代理人将自己的解释视为意见已经确立了这种关系,就会产生失败。

blocks.en: To analyse how narrative construction contributed to this effect, we compared the complete procedure with simplified variants on Charlie Hebdo. Acceptance reached 77.0% under the complete procedure, compared with 26.8% for a single agent using one prompt. Removing Director-guided revision or Editor sequencing also reduced acceptance (Extended Data Table Extended Data ), suggesting that both iterative refinement and narrative presentation contributed to the attack’s effectiveness. These comparisons indicate that susceptibility depended in part on how the material was developed and organized into a persuasive account. On the receiving side, chain-of-thought prompting increased acceptance rate in Qwen2.5-7B and DeepSeek-R1-7B (Extended Data Table Extended Data ). Thus, explicitly asking these models to reason through the evidence did not prevent unsupported conclusions. Additional reasoning may instead elaborate an initially plausible interpretation without checking whether its connecting assumptions are grounded, consistent with evidence that reasoning traces can rationalize answers shaped by input biases [ 45 ] . Our separate ablation analysis further showed that acceptance peaked at intermediate feed lengths before declining (Extended Data Fig. Extended Data ). Persuasiveness therefore did not increase consistently as more material was presented: within this evaluation, extending a feed could strengthen or weaken target acceptance. These findings suggest that narrative construction, the receiving model’s reasoning behaviour and feed length interact in ways that cannot be reduced to a simple expectation that more reasoning or more information will improve judgement.
blocks.zh: 为了分析叙事构造如何促进这种效果,我们把完整的程序与查理·赫布多的简化变体进行比较. 在完全程序下,接受率达到77.0%,而使用一个即时的单一制剂为26.8%。 删除主任指导的修订或编辑顺序也降低了接受率(扩展数据表),这表明迭代改进和叙述性表述都有助于攻击的有效性。 这些比较表明,易感性部分取决于材料是如何开发并组织成有说服力的说明的。 在接收方,思维链促使在Quen2.5-7B和DeepSeek-R1-7B(扩展数据表扩展数据)中提高接受率。 因此,明确要求这些模型通过证据说明理由并不妨碍得出无根据的结论。 相反,其他推理可能阐述一种初步可信的解释,而不检查其关联性假设是否有依据,这符合推理痕迹可以使输入偏差形成的答复合理化的证据[45]。 我们的单独衰减分析进一步表明,接受量在下降之前在中间饲料长度达到高峰(Extend Data Fig.扩展数据)。 因此,由于提供了更多的材料,劝导性没有持续提高:在本次评价中,提供饲料可以加强或削弱目标接受程度。 这些调查结果表明,叙述构造、接收模型的推理行为和饲料长度相互作用的方式不能简化为单纯的预期,即更多的推理或更多信息将改善判断。

blocks.en: Error propagation from victim agents to downstream decision systems
blocks.zh: 受害者代理人向下游决策系统传播错误

blocks.en: Having established that individual victim agents accept unsupported conclusions, we next examined whether these errors persist when their outputs inform a downstream decision system. We tested two common routes to a final target judgement. Majority voting [ 46 ] combined the five victim agents’ target verdicts, whereas an additional language-model judge [ 47 ] reviewed the original feed alongside all five fixed initial reports, including their reasoning and self-reported confidence. The first route relied on agreement among the agents; the second allowed a downstream decision-maker to examine their interpretations against the original evidence. These routes therefore tested whether aggregation or further review could prevent unsupported interpretations from becoming final decisions.
blocks.zh: 在确定个别受害者代理人接受无根据结论之后,我们接着审查这些错误是否在下游决策系统得到结果时继续存在。 我们测试了两条通向最终目标判断的路线。 多数人投票[46]将5名受害者代理人的目标判决合并起来,而另外一名语言模型法官[47]对所有5份固定的初次报告,包括其推理和自我报告的信任,一并审查了原始材料。 第一种途径依靠代理人之间的协议;第二种途径允许下游决策者对照原始证据审查他们的解释。 因此,这些途径检验汇总或进一步审查是否可以防止无根据的解释成为最后决定。

blocks.en: Under majority voting, a target was accepted only when most agents endorsed it, following a rule widely used in human collective decision-making. Yet rumour acceptance remained at 59.6–75.0% across the evaluated model groups (Fig. 1 c). This result highlights how apparent consensus can obscure the evidential gaps behind a shared conclusion. When several analysts endorse the same rumour, their agreement may be mistaken for independent corroboration, making the claim appear more credible than the underlying observations warrant. Human studies have shown that repeated expressions from a single source can create an impression of broader agreement [ 16 ] . In our setting, majority voting translates convergent but unsupported interpretations into a final system decision. Such collective endorsement may then discourage further scrutiny by making an unresolved claim appear settled. The resulting risk extends to subsequent information exchange, where other agents or human users may repeat the conclusion on the strength of that apparent consensus, allowing a rumour to circulate with increasing credibility while its evidential basis remains unchanged.
blocks.zh: 在多数投票中,只有在大多数代理人赞同时,才接受一个目标,遵循在人类集体决策中广泛使用的规则。 然而,所有被评价的模型组(图1c)的传闻接受率仍为59.6-75.0%。 这一结果突出表明,显而易见的共识能够掩盖共同结论背后的证据差距。 如果一些分析家赞同同样的谣言,他们的同意可能被误认为是独立的佐证,使这一说法看起来比基本意见更可信。 人类的研究表明,单一来源的重复表达会给人一种更广泛的一致印象[16]. 在我们的环境下,多数投票将趋同但未得到支持的解释转化为最后的系统决定。 这样一来,这种集体认可可能会阻止进一步审查,使一项未解决的索赔似乎得到解决。 由此产生的风险延伸到随后的信息交流,其他代理人或人类使用者可能根据这种明显的共识重复结论,允许谣言在证据基础保持不变的情况下以越来越可信的方式传播。

blocks.en: The language-model judge could inspect the original feed alongside all five agents’ structured reports, giving it an opportunity to assess whether their reasoning was grounded in the source material. Nevertheless, rumour acceptance remained at 57.7–69.5%, exceeding half the targets in every evaluated model group. Access to both the evidence and the accompanying explanations therefore did not reliably prevent unsupported conclusions from reaching the final decision. This raises a concern about how persuasive reasoning can shape subsequent review. A structured report may explain how an agent arrived at a conclusion while leaving the crucial connection between the observations and the target unverified. Its self-reported confidence may further make that interpretation appear settled, without resolving the underlying uncertainty. A downstream judge could consequently treat a coherent explanation as sufficient justification, allowing an inferred relationship to pass through review without being established by the evidence. Extended Data Fig. Extended Data reports the event-level results. Across both decision routes, these findings show that unsupported interpretations can survive aggregation and further assessment. The broader risk is that passing through these stages may give a rumour the appearance of having been checked and validated, increasing its apparent authority when the final decision is communicated to other agents or human users.
blocks.zh: 语言模型法官可以检查原始材料以及所有五个代理人的结构化报告,从而有机会评估他们的推理是否基于来源材料。 尽管如此,传闻的接受率仍为57.7-69.5%,超过了每个被评价的模型组目标的一半. 因此,查阅证据和随附的解释并不能可靠地阻止无根据的结论作出最后决定。 这引起了人们对说服力推理如何影响后续审查的关切。 一份有条理的报告可以解释一个代理人如何得出结论,同时使观察和目标之间的重要联系得不到核实。 其自报的信心可能进一步使这种解释看起来得到确定,而不会解决潜在的不确定性。 因此,下游法官可将一致的解释视为充分的理由,允许推断的关系通过复审而无需证据证实。 扩展数据图 。 扩展数据报告事件级结果。 这些调查结果表明,在两种决策路线上,无根据的解释可以经受汇总和进一步评估。 更大的风险是,经过这些阶段,可能会传出已被检查和验证的谣言,从而在最后决定传达给其他代理人或人类使用者时,会增加其明显的权威。

blocks.en: Belief in rumours weakens when influential fragments are removed
blocks.zh: 当有影响力的碎片被清除后,对谣言的信仰就会减弱

Marginal curves show the distributions of these pooled scores.

blocks.en: To understand how these attacks shape judgement, we moved beyond aggregate success rates to identify which truthful fragments influence the victim’s response and whether that influence persists within the complete narrative. We first measured each post’s effect in isolation, selected the strongest candidate and then modified the feed to test its contribution to the overall judgement. This analysis used a separate corpus containing 223 attack feeds spanning 37 targets and 464 ordinary-report feeds from the same events. We evaluated these feeds with six open-weight models to access token log-probabilities at the first answer position for quantifying changes in target belief. The attack feeds had been selected for success under a reference model’s fixed belief readout, thus the comparison focused on successful attack constructions and ordinary reporting.
blocks.zh: 为了了解这些攻击如何影响判断,我们超越了总的成功率,找出哪些真实的碎片影响受害者的反应,以及这种影响是否在完整叙述中持续存在。 我们先是孤立地衡量每个职位的效果, 这项分析使用了一个单独的文体,其中包括涉及37个目标的223个攻击资料和来自同一事件的464个普通报告资料。 我们用6个开放量模型评估了这些信息,在第一个答案位置访问符号日志概率,以量化目标信仰的变化。 攻击素材是在参考模型的固定信念读取中选择成功的,因此比较的重点是成功的攻击构造和普通报告。

blocks.en: A model’s response to a complete feed can conceal substantial differences between its responses to individual posts. Two feeds may produce similar overall target beliefs even when their constituent fragments exert very different influences. To distinguish these patterns, we expressed the probability of answering TRUE as a log-odds belief margin . Positive values favour TRUE, negative values favour FALSE, and larger values indicate a stronger tendency to accept the target. The full-feed belief margin measures this tendency when all posts are presented together. Each post’s belief pull , instead measures how the margin changes when that post is presented alone, relative to an empty-context baseline. A positive pull therefore increases target belief relative to the baseline, whereas a negative pull decreases it. We then defined response dispersion as the sample standard deviation across these isolated pulls. Greater dispersion indicates that posts differ more strongly in their individual effects, whether those effects point in the same direction or in opposing directions.
blocks.zh: 模型对完整信息的反应可以掩盖其对个别员额的反应之间的巨大差异。 两种饲料可能产生类似的总目标信仰,即使其成分片段施加了非常不同的影响。 为了区分这些模式,我们表达了回答TRUE作为对数信差的概率。 积极值偏好TRUE,消极值偏好FALSE,较大值表明接受目标的趋势更强. 当所有职位都一并列出时,全方位的信仰比值衡量这一趋势。 每个员额的信念是拉动的,相反,相对于一个空文本基线,衡量该员额单列时差值的变化。 因此,正拉比基线提高目标信念,负拉比基线减少。 然后我们把反应分散定义为这些孤立拉力的样本标准偏差。 更大的分散性表明,员额的个别影响差异更大,无论这些影响指向同一方向还是相反方向。

blocks.en: We therefore explored whether full-feed belief or response dispersion better distinguished attack feeds from ordinary reporting in Fig. 2 . For each readout, we converted each feed’s score into a percentile rank within each model and averaged these ranks across the six models, placing the model-specific scores on a common ranking scale before the pooled comparison. The pooled area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) was 0.72 for dispersion, compared with 0.55 for full-feed belief. Thus, variation across isolated fragment responses separated the two groups more clearly than the model’s overall tendency to accept the target. The distinction was not uniform across models, however, and Extended Data Table Extended Data reports the corresponding model-specific results.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们探索了是否将信仰或反应的散射从Fig的普通报道中更好地区分出攻击内容。 2 (英语). 对于每个读出,我们把每个种子的分数转换成每个模型中的百分位,并在六个模型中平均这些分位,在集合比较之前将模型特定分数放在一个共同的分位表上。 接收器操作特征曲线(AUROC)下的集合区为分散区0.72,而全食信仰区为0.55。 因此,孤立的零散答复之间的差异比模型接受目标的总体趋势更清楚地区分了这两个组别。 然而,不同模型之间的区别并不一致,扩展数据表扩展数据报告相应的具体模型结果。

blocks.en: To examine whether these isolated responses identified fragments that also influenced judgement within the complete narrative, we tested the selected posts through deletion interventions [ 48 , 49 ] . For each of the six models, we selected the post with the highest belief pull as the payload and compared its removal with deletion of a randomly selected non-payload post. The original and modified feeds were re-evaluated under seven prompt templates, with both deletions removing exactly one post. Relative to the original feed, larger decreases in full-feed belief after payload deletion tended to accompany larger decreases in dispersion across all six models, as shown in Fig. 3 a. Compared with random deletion, removing the payload produced greater reductions in both measures in the first two rows of Fig. 3 b, with a cross-model mean difference in belief margin of − 2.73 -2.73 nats (95% confidence interval, − 3.30 -3.30 to − 2.26 -2.26 ). This greater reduction in belief was accompanied by more frequent changes in the final verdict in Fig. 3 c, where payload deletion reversed a TRUE verdict in a mean of 15.5% of the 223 attack feeds, compared with 4.8% after random deletion. These controlled comparisons provide causal evidence that fragments identified through isolated responses also influence judgement within the complete narrative.
blocks.zh: 为了审查这些孤立的答复是否找出了影响整个叙述中判断的片段,我们通过删除干预措施测试了所选段落[48、49]。 对于这六个型号中的每一个,我们选择了具有最高信念拉力的哨所作为有效载荷,并将其去除与删除随机选定的非载荷哨所进行比较。 原始和修改过的种子在7个即时模板下重新评价,两个删除部分都完全删除了一个帖子. 与原始饲料相比,如图所示,在删除有效载荷后,全部饲料的信念减少幅度较大,这往往伴随着所有6种模型的分散程度的减少。 3a. 与随机删除相比,除去有效载荷在图3b的前两行中使这两种措施都得到了更大的削减,在信仰差值上跨模型的平均差值为−2.73-2.73纳特(95%的置信间隔,−3.30-3.30至−2.26-2.26)。 随着信念的更大减少,在图3c中最终判决更频繁的改变,有效载荷删除以223个攻击种子中15.5%的平均值逆转TRUE判决,而随机删除后的比例为4.8%. 这些有控制的比较提供了因果证据,表明通过孤立的反应而发现的碎片也会影响整个叙述中的判断。

blocks.en: We then tested whether the same fragments could strengthen target belief beyond their original narratives by inserting each model’s payload into 349 ordinary-report feeds from the same event. Although insertion increased dispersion across all six models, as shown in the bottom row of Fig. 3 b, the changes in full-feed belief differed in direction across models. The cross-model mean belief change was + 0.08 +0.08 nats, with a 95% confidence interval from − 0.04 -0.04 to + 0.20 +0.20 , as reported in Extended Data Table Extended Data . The inserted fragments therefore altered the distribution of isolated responses without consistently strengthening belief in the complete feed. Their influence on full-feed judgement depended on the surrounding narrative, leaving open whether similar response patterns could also arise when the fragments provide valid evidence for the target.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们通过将每个模型的有效载荷插入来自同一事件的349个普通报告素材,测试同样的碎片是否能够加强目标信念。 虽然如图3b的下行所示,插入增加了所有六个模型的分散性,但全素信仰的变化在不同的模型中的方向有所不同。 如扩展数据表扩展数据所报告,跨模型的平均信仰变化为+0.08+0.08纳特,置信间隔为−0.04-0.04+0.20+0.20。 因此,插入的碎片改变了孤立反应的分布,而没有始终加强对完整饲料的信念。 它们对全素判断的影响取决于周围的叙述,在碎片为目标提供有效证据时,是否也会出现类似的反应模式,则尚不明确.

blocks.en: The aforementioned analysis showed that selected fragments influence judgement within their original narratives, while transplantation increased dispersion without consistently strengthening belief in a different feed. These findings, however, do not establish whether the response patterns distinguish misleading inference from valid evidence integration. We therefore designed controlled comparisons in synthetic worlds with known facts and relations, where target truth and evidential support could be checked directly. We first varied fragment selection and narrative construction, and then examined whether similar response patterns arose when the fragments established the target. Alongside the six models used in the fragment analysis, we evaluated Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B to test whether the response patterns extend to further model generation or different family.
blocks.zh: 上述分析表明,一些选定的碎片会影响其原始叙述中的判断,而移植则会增加分散,而不会不断增强对不同饲料的信念。 然而,这些调查结果并不能确定反应模式是否将误导性推断与有效证据整合区分开来。 因此,我们设计了在合成世界中与已知事实和关系进行有控制的比较,可以直接检查目标真相和证据支持。 我们首先对片段进行不同的选择和叙述,然后审查片段确定目标时是否出现类似的反应模式。 除了在碎片分析中使用的六个模型之外,我们评价了Qune3-8B和Llama-3.1-8B,以检验反应模式是否扩大到进一步的模型生成或不同的家族。

blocks.en: Figure 4 a presents five construction comparisons, with each row representing a model and each cell giving the dispersion AUROC. Values above 0.5 indicate higher dispersion in the first condition and below 0.5 in the reference condition, whereas values near 0.5 indicate little separation. The first two columns, under Evidence selection, compare fragments chosen by a fixed target-aware scorer with randomly sampled relevant fragments. These comparisons vary selection within each presentation format, using the same short template in the Fragments column and the same Writer, Editor and Director pipeline in the Narratives column. Scorer selection modestly increased dispersion in short templates but not consistently in narratives. The next two columns, under Attack search, compare complete attacks that search the full evidence pool with narratives generated from scorer-selected fragments (Selected control) or randomly sampled relevant fragments (Random control). Both controls retain unsupported targets; the latter, termed curation-free narratives, retain the full generation pipeline while omitting adversarial evidence selection. Complete attacks showed little separation from this control, matched in fragment count and approximate length, with AUROCs of 0.42–0.55, and no consistent increase over the scorer-selected control. By contrast, the final column, Full pipeline, compares attacks with randomly sampled relevant fragments in short templates and yields AUROCs of 0.90–1.00, jointly changing selection, presentation and length. Dispersion can therefore separate attacks from short fragments while showing little separation from narratives generated without adversarial evidence selection. Extended Data Table Extended Data reports all five comparisons and their confidence intervals.
blocks.zh: 图4a显示5个构造比较,每行代表一个模型,每个单元格显示分散的AUROC。 0.5以上的数值表明,第一个条件的分散度较高,参考条件的分散度低于0.5,而接近0.5的数值则表明没有多少分离。 在证据选择下,前两栏将固定目标识别计分员选择的碎片与随机取样的相关碎片进行比较。 这些比较在每种演示文稿格式内都不同选择,在Fragments栏中使用相同的短模板,在叙述栏使用相同的Writer,编辑和主任管道. 评分员的选择略微增加了短模板的分散,但叙述部分却不一致。 接下来的两个栏目,在"攻击搜索"下,将搜索全部证据集合的完整攻击与计分器选取的碎片(部分控制)或随机取样的相关碎片(Random控制)生成的叙述进行比较. 这两种控制都保留了无支持的目标;后者称为无责备叙事,保留了全代的管道,同时省去了对抗性的证据选择. 完整的攻击显示,与这种控制没有多大区别,与碎片计数和大约长度相匹配,AUROCs为0.42-0.55,比起计分员选定的控制,没有持续增加。 相比之下,最后一栏 " Full project " 将攻击与短模板中随机抽样的相关碎片进行比较,得出0.90-1.00的AUROCs,共同改变选择、列报和长度。 因此,散射可以将攻击与短片区分开来,同时在不选择对抗性证据的情况下,很少与产生的叙述区分开来. 扩展数据表扩展数据报告所有五个比较及其置信间隔.

blocks.en: These construction controls changed fragment selection while leaving the target unsupported. We therefore next used the same generation pipeline to construct supported narratives whose targets were established directly or through multiple inferential steps. Qwen2.5-7B and the two additional models accepted these targets at rates of 96.3–100.0% across the direct and multi-step conditions. Figure 4 b compares attacks and curation-free narratives against this supported reference, with one point per model. The horizontal coordinate gives the attack AUROC and the vertical coordinate the curation-free AUROC; in either comparison, values below 0.5 indicate higher dispersion in the supported group. Qwen3-8B lies at approximately ( 0.28 , 0.29 ) (0.28,0.29) , indicating higher dispersion in supported narratives than in either unsupported condition. The Qwen2.5-7B point estimates also fall below 0.5, whereas the Llama-3.1-8B estimates are close to 0.5. Valid evidence can thus produce response differences across fragments that are comparable to, or greater than, those observed in misleading narratives.
blocks.zh: 这些构造控制改变片段选择,同时使目标不支持. 因此,我们接下来利用同一代管道来构建支持性叙述,其目标是直接或通过多重推断步骤确定的。 Quen2.5-7B和另外两个模式在直接和多步骤条件下以96.3-100.0%的比率接受了这些目标。 图4b将攻击和免责叙述与这一支持的参考相比较,每个模型各1点。 水平坐标给攻击AUROC和垂直坐标给无曲折的AUROC;在两个比较中,0.5以下的数值表示被支持组的分散度较高. Qune3-8B位于大约(0.28,0.29)左右(0.28,0.29),表明在支持的叙事中比在不支持的状态下更分散. Quen2.5-7B点的估计数也低于0.5,而Llama-3.1-8B的估计数接近0.5。 因此,有效证据可以产生不同片段的反应差异,这些差异与误导性叙述中所观察到的差异相当或更大。

blocks.en: To test whether these similar responses limit screening based on dispersion, we set a threshold at each model’s 90th percentile in the short-fragment control and applied it to attack, curation-free and supported narratives. In Fig. 4 c, each coloured ring segment shows the percentage of feeds exceeding it, with grey showing the remainder. Supported narratives exceeded it in 81–100% of feeds, alongside high proportions of attack and curation-free narratives. A rule calibrated on short fragments would therefore flag many supported narratives as well as attacks. Extended Data Table Extended Data provides the complete comparisons and target-acceptance rates, which are distinct from these threshold-exceedance percentages. Together with the deletion experiment, these findings separate the influence of a fragment from the support it provides. Both decisive evidence and an unsupported suggestion can contribute to narrative coherence, consistent with cognitive accounts of explanation and evidence integration [ 19 , 20 ] . These findings motivate a monitoring strategy that examines whether a narrative’s conclusion is supported by the fragments or depends on assumptions that the evidence does not establish.
blocks.zh: 为了测试这些类似的反应是否限制基于散射的筛选,我们设定了每个模型在短裂控制中的第90百分位的阈值,并将其应用于攻击,免责和支持的叙述. 以法义. 4c,每个彩色环线段显示饲料超过其的百分比,灰色显示其余部分. 支持的叙述在81-100%的饲料中超过了它,同时还有高比例的攻击和免责的叙述。 因此,对短片进行校准的规则,将标志着许多得到支持的叙述和攻击。 扩展数据表扩展数据提供了完整的比较和目标接受率,这些百分比不同于这些阈值超过百分比。 连同删除实验,这些发现将碎片的影响与它所提供的支持分开. 决定性证据和不支持的建议都有助于叙述的一致性,与认知解释和证据整合相一致[19,20]. 这些调查结果促使采取一项监测战略,审查叙述的结论是否得到片段的支持,或取决于证据不能证实的假设。

blocks.en: Target promotion and direct support provide distinct diagnostic information
blocks.zh: 目标宣传和直接支助提供独特的诊断信息

blocks.en: The preceding analyses showed that influential fragments can shape judgement through either valid evidence or unsupported inference. This distinction motivates checking how the presented content supports a target, beyond measuring how strongly it affects the response. We therefore use GM as a proof-of-concept neuro-symbolic monitor before target judgement. Its neural component interprets each post’s relation to the target, while its symbolic component checks whether detected direct support remains after abductive assumptions are withdrawn. GM uses this assessment to flag narratives that strongly promote a target without detected single-post grounding. We first examined what this signal distinguishes across different feed types, before testing whether communicating it changes victim agents’ judgements.
blocks.zh: 上述分析表明,有影响力的碎片可以通过有效证据或无根据的推论形成判断。 这种区分除了衡量对反应的影响程度外,还促使人们检查所介绍的内容如何支持目标。 因此,在作出目标判断之前,我们使用GM作为概念的证明神经系统监测器。 其神经元解释每个员额与目标的关系,而其象征性元件则检查所发现的直接支持是否在绑架性假设被撤回后仍然存在. 全球机制利用这一评估来标出大力宣传一个目标而不检测到的单岗地面的叙述。 我们首先检查这个信号在不同饲料类型之间有何区别,然后检验它是否改变受害者代理人的判断。

blocks.en: For these experiments, we used a focused set comprising 158 unique rumour targets and 80 non-rumour controls, with both groups composed into montages using the same procedure. The original setting (ORIG) retained the real entities, whereas the anonymized setting (ANON) replaced them with fictional counterparts before regenerating the feeds. Regeneration reduced rumour acceptance, and fixed-text controls showed that differences between generation sources were larger than the effect of replacing names within an otherwise unchanged feed. ORIG and ANON therefore differ in their generated narratives as well as their entity names. Evaluating GM in both settings tests whether its support assessment remains informative across these changes in the presented content. Extended Data Tables Extended Data and Extended Data report the anonymization and fixed-text controls, respectively.
blocks.zh: 对于这些实验,我们使用了一套有重点的,包括158个独特的谣言目标和80个非鲁穆尔控制,两个组组成蒙塔吉斯使用同样的程序. 原始设置(ORIG)保留了真实的实体,而无名化设置(ANON)则在重新生成种子之前用虚构的对应物代替它们. 重新生成降低了谣言的接受率,固定文本控制显示,生成源之间的差异大于在原未改变的种子中替换名称的效果. 因此,ORIG和ANON在生成的叙述及其实体名称上各不相同。 在两种情况下评估全球机制,测试其支助评估是否在所介绍内容的这些变化中仍然提供信息。 扩展数据表扩展数据和扩展数据分别报告匿名化和固定文本控制.

blocks.en: To distinguish target promotion from evidential support, a frozen GPT-4.1-mini classifier assigned each post one of four relations to the target: grounds , abductive , undermines or irrelevant , following Extended Data Table Extended Data . A grounding post would establish the target if accurate, whereas an abductive post makes the target plausible without establishing it. This distinction addresses the ambiguity exposed by the mechanism analysis: a fragment can encourage acceptance either by supplying sufficient evidence or by inviting an additional assumption. The symbolic step withdrew abductive assumptions from its support representation and, in this single-target setting, checked whether any grounding post remained. Earlier posts served only to resolve references when assessing an individual post; they were not combined to establish the target through multiple inferential steps. The implemented criterion therefore records detected single-post direct support. The victim agent continued to receive the complete feed in its original order.
blocks.zh: 为了区分目标晋升和证据支持,冻结的GPT-4.1-mini分类器为目标分配了四个关系中的一个:理由、绑架、破坏或不相关,如下: 扩展数据表扩展数据 。 地面站如果准确,就可确定目标,而绑架站则使目标不成立而令人信服。 这种区分解决了机制分析所暴露的模糊性:一个片段可以通过提供足够的证据或邀请额外的假设来鼓励接受. 这一象征性步骤从支助代表中撤回了绑架性假设,并在这一单一目标设定中检查是否还保留了任何固定员额。 先前的员额在评估某个员额时只是为了解决参考问题;这些员额并没有通过多重推断步骤合并确定目标。 因此,执行的标准记录了发现的单员额直接支助。 受害人代理人继续收到原订单的完整饲料。

blocks.en: The same relation labels also quantify how strongly a feed promotes its target. We call this score salience , calculated from normalized label counts and clipped to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , as specified in Methods. Belief pull measures the change in the victim agent’s belief margin relative to an empty context, whereas salience summarizes an external assessment of the posts’ semantic relations to the target. It therefore describes target promotion rather than directly measuring influence on the victim. GM combines salience with the symbolic support check in an alarm , which fires when salience is at least 0.5 and no grounding post is detected. The rule identifies a specific evidential concern: the narrative promotes a target, but no individual post has been identified as directly establishing it.
blocks.zh: 同样的关联标签也量化了饲料如何大力促进其目标. 我们称此分数为显著值, 相信量度受害者代理人的信仰幅度相对于空洞背景的变化,而显要之处则总结了对员额与目标语义关系的外部评估。 因此,它描述了目标促进,而不是直接衡量对受害者的影响。 GM将显著性与符号支持检查结合起来, 该规则确定了具体的证据关切:叙述促进目标,但没有确定任何个人员额直接设立目标。

blocks.en: Table 2: Target promotion and direct support address different diagnostic comparisons. Results are shown for ORIG. The upper block compares non-rumour control and attack montages generated by the same pipeline, with non-rumour control montages treated as the positive class for AUROC. The lower block compares attack montages with chronological control feeds from the same events (Methods); its AUROC uses salience, and the alarm rates correspond to recall and false-positive rate within this comparison.
blocks.zh: 表2:目标推广和直接支助涉及不同的诊断比较。 ORIG显示结果. 上部块比较了同一条管道产生的非Rumour控制和攻击蒙盘,非Rumour控制蒙盘则作为AUROC的正类处理. 下区块将攻击蒙太奇与同一事件(方法)的时序控制素相比;其AUROC使用显著性,警报率与这次比较中的召回率和假阳性率相对应.

blocks.en: We first compared rumour and non-rumour montages generated by the same procedure. Both groups were constructed to encourage acceptance of their targets, and salience provided almost no discrimination between them, with an AUROC of 0.502. Grounding-post counts were more informative, yielding an AUROC of 0.664 (Table 2 , upper block). Grounding was detected in 38.8% of non-rumour controls and 6.3% of rumour montages, and this contrast persisted in ANON, as shown in Extended Data Table Extended Data . These results distinguish target promotion from detected direct support: similarly target-directed narratives can differ in whether their individual posts establish the conclusion they encourage. Grounding labels therefore provide information that salience alone does not capture.
blocks.zh: 我们首先比较了同一程序产生的谣言和非鲁木的蒙太奇。 这两个群体都是为鼓励接受其目标而组建的,其显著地位几乎没有在他们之间造成任何歧视,AUROC为0.502。 地面站的清点资料更加丰富,得出了0.664(表2,上区块)。 如扩展数据表扩展数据所示,在38.8%的非鲁姆控制区和6.3%的谣言密闭区中都检测到了地面,在ANON中这种对比仍然存在。 这些成果将目标晋升与发现的直接支持区分开来:同样,目标导向的叙述可能因个人职位是否得出鼓励的结论而有所不同。 因此,打地标可以提供仅显要不能捕捉的信息。

blocks.en: Illustrative example. Consider the target “The airport has closed.” A feed repeatedly describing delayed flights, crowded terminals and stranded passengers may make this conclusion seem plausible, but none of these observations establishes that the airport has closed. A second feed containing a post that quotes an accurate official notice announcing the closure would provide direct support. Both feeds can promote the same conclusion and therefore have high salience, but the second contains a grounding post. The relevant distinction is whether the observations establish the conclusion that the narrative encourages the reader to accept.
blocks.zh: 譬喻如来. 把目标视为“机场已经关闭”。 一再描述航班延误、航站楼拥挤和乘客搁浅的资讯可能使这一结论显得合理,但这些观察都没有证实机场已经关闭。 另一条内容包括一篇文章, 两种信息都能够促进同一结论,因此具有很高的知名度,但第二种信息包含一个固定位置。 相关的区别在于意见是否确立了说明鼓励读者接受的结论.

blocks.en: We next compared rumour montages with chronological control feeds from the same events, matched by target and post count. These controls presented sampled reports in timestamp order without composing them around the target. Salience separated the groups with an AUROC of 0.980, and the combined alarm detected 91.1% of attack feeds with a 4.4% false-positive rate on the chronological controls, as shown in the lower block of Table 2 . Together, these comparisons show that salience captures target-directed composition, while grounding adds information about direct support within that composition. GM combines them to make a specific evidential concern explicit, giving victim agents a concrete basis for reconsidering the connection between the original feed and their conclusion.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来比较了谣言和时间顺序控制 来自同一事件, 匹配的目标数和后计数。 这些管制按时间戳顺序提交抽样报告,而不将报告放在目标周围。 如表2的下方块所示,显著位置将各组分离,AUROC为0.980,综合警报检测到91.1%的攻击饲料,在时间顺序控制上误差率为4.4%。 这些比较加在一起表明,突出的成分能捕捉到目标导向的成分,而打地基则会增加关于该成分中直接支持的信息. 全球机制将它们结合起来,明确提出具体的证据关切,为受害者代理人重新审视原始饲料与其结论之间的联系提供具体依据。

blocks.en: Practical defensive value of runtime monitoring
blocks.zh: 运行时间监测的实际防御价值

blocks.en: The mechanism analysis directs attention to key fragments and to whether the implicit connections linking them to a conclusion are supported by evidence or supplied by the model. The preceding GM analysis examined this distinction through salience and grounding, separating target promotion from detected direct support in Table 2 . We therefore tested whether communicating this assessment improves agents’ acceptance decisions about the same narrative. The GM response condition added an uncertain option that allows an agent to withhold acceptance and can serve as a request for human review in deployment. When the alarm fired, a fixed warning also stated that no post had been detected as directly supporting the target. We evaluated four models on the 158 rumour targets and 80 non-rumour controls, scoring their own decisions as correct for rumour non-acceptance and non-rumour acceptance. FALSE and UNCERTAIN both count as non-acceptance, with equal weight per target.
blocks.zh: 机制分析提请注意关键碎片,以及将它们与结论联系起来的隐含联系是证据支持还是模型提供。 上文全球机制的分析通过突出地位和立足点审查了这种区别,将目标促进与表2中发现的直接支持区分开来。 因此,我们检验这种评估的传播是否改善代理人对同一叙述的接受决定。 全球机制的反应条件增加了一种不确定的选择,允许代理人拒绝接受,并可作为部署中进行人文审查的请求。 当警报响起时,一个固定的警告还说,没有发现任何哨所直接支持目标。 我们评价了158个谣言目标中的4个模型和80个非鲁鲁尔控制,认为他们自己的决定是正确的,因为谣言不接受和不鲁鲁尔接受. FALSE和UNCERPAD都算作不接受,每个目标重量相等.

blocks.en: Figure 5: GM improves acceptance decisions across models and entity settings. a , ORIG. b , ANON. Grey bars show baseline judgements and blue bars show judgements under the GM response condition. Decision accuracy counts acceptance of a non-rumour control and non-acceptance of a rumour target as correct, pooling 158 rumour targets and 80 non-rumour controls with equal weight per target. Each target was judged in five runs. Both FALSE and UNCERTAIN count as non-acceptance. The GM response condition adds an uncertain option and provides a fixed warning when the monitor raises an alarm.
blocks.zh: 图5:全球机制改进各种模式和实体的接受决定。 a, ORIG.b, ANON. (中文(简体) ). 灰条显示基线判断,蓝条显示在GM响应条件下判断. 决定准确性将接受非鲁木管制和不接受谣言目标视为正确,集中158个谣言目标和80个非鲁木管制,每个目标重量相等. 每个目标在5次评测中被评测. FALSE和UNCERDED都算作不接受. 全球机制的反应条件增加了一个不确定的选项,并在显示器发出警报时提供固定的警告.

blocks.en: Under this criterion, responding to GM improved decision accuracy across all four models in both settings , with gains of 11.2–29.0 percentage points in ORIG and 5.6–13.7 points in ANON, as shown in Fig. 5 a,b, respectively. These gains were obtained with the complete feeds unchanged, showing that agents can use the support assessment together with the option to withhold judgement to improve acceptance decisions while retaining the truthful fragments. Accuracy with GM was higher in ANON than in ORIG for every model, reaching 68.3–76.8%. ANON also had higher baseline accuracy and used regenerated narratives as well as fictional entity names; the improvements within each setting therefore demonstrate the value of responding to GM, whereas the difference between settings also reflects changes in the narratives being assessed.
blocks.zh: 根据这一标准,全球机制在两种情况下都提高了所有四种模型的决策准确性,在ORIG和ANON分别提高了11.2–29.0个百分点和5.6–13.7个百分点,如图5 a,b所示。 这些收益是在完整信息源不变的情况下取得的,表明代理人可以使用支助评估,同时选择不作判断,改进接受决定,同时保留真实的碎片。 ANON对GM的精确度高于ORIG对每个模型的精确度,达到68.3%-76.8%. ANON还具有更高的基线准确性,并使用了重新生成的叙述以及虚构的实体名称;因此,每个设定中的改进都显示了对全球机制作出反应的价值,而设定之间的差异也反映了正在评估的叙述的变化。

blocks.en: As the alarm concerns detected direct support, its interpretation also depends on the type of claim being assessed. A supplementary analysis compared atomic targets, which state an individual fact, with inferential targets, which express an interpretation of the supplied fragments. In our sample drawn from real Twitter events in PHEME, atomic claims accounted for 75.9% of rumour targets and 90.0% of non-rumour controls. Grounding was detected in 40.3% of atomic and 25.0% of inferential non-rumour controls, while remaining uncommon for both rumour types, as detailed in Extended Data Table Extended Data . The predominance of atomic claims makes direct-support checking relevant to much of this sample, while the lower detection rate for inferential controls draws attention to conclusions whose support may depend on combining fragments. Following an alarm, an uncertain judgement could therefore request human review of the relationship between the fragments and the conclusion, including whether further evidence is needed or the available fragments jointly establish the claim. This would provide a route to verification before an unresolved interpretation informs downstream reports or decisions, where our earlier shared-feed review experiments showed that errors can persist despite agreement among agents.
blocks.zh: 由于对警报的关切发现直接支持,其解释也取决于所评估的索赔类型。 一项补充分析对原子目标进行了比较,这些原子目标陈述了个别事实,带有推断目标,对所提供的碎片作了解释。 原子索赔占谣言目标的75.9%, 在40.3%的原子控制和25.0%的推论性非鲁木控制中检测到地面,而对于这两种传闻类型来说,如扩展数据表扩展数据所详述的,地面仍然很罕见。 原子主张的主导性使得直接支持检查与大部分样本相关,而推断控制的检测率较低则提醒人们注意其支持可能取决于组合碎片的结论. 因此,在发出警报后,不确定的判断可能要求人们审查碎片与结论之间的关系,包括是否需要进一步的证据,还是现有的碎片共同证明索赔。 这将提供一个在未解决的解释告知下游报告或决定之前进行核查的途径,我们先前的共同资料审查试验显示,尽管各代理人之间达成了协议,错误仍可能持续存在。

blocks.en: Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论情况

blocks.en: Belief formation through narrative coherence
blocks.zh: 通过叙事一致性形成信仰

blocks.en: When an agent combines truthful fragments into a narrative, it can mistake a relationship that it has inferred for one that the fragments have established. In our study, removing influential posts indeed weakened rumour belief in their original narratives, whereas transferring them to ordinary reporting did not consistently strengthen belief. Similar variation in responses to individual fragments occurred in both misleading narratives and narratives whose conclusions were supported. Influence therefore helps locate content that shapes judgement, but assessing whether that influence is justified requires checking how the fragments support the conclusion.
blocks.zh: 当一个特工将真实的碎片合并到一个叙述中时,它可能会错误地判断出它所推断的碎片已经建立的关系. 在我们的研究中,去除有影响力的帖子确实削弱了谣言对其最初叙述的信念,而将其转移到普通报告上并没有始终加强信仰。 在对个别片段的反应方面,在误导性的叙述和结论得到支持的叙述中也出现了类似的差异。 因此,影响有助于确定影响判断的内容,但评估这种影响是否合理,需要检查碎片如何支持结论。

blocks.en: Cognitive accounts of judgement help explain this risk by describing how an emerging explanation shapes the interpretation of individual facts [ 19 , 20 ] . If coherence guides an agent’s judgement, it may accept a connecting assumption because that assumption makes the narrative fit together. Research on source monitoring addresses the related problem of distinguishing externally supplied information from internally generated interpretations [ 50 ] . For agents, keeping track of which relationships were reported and which were inferred would allow a plausible explanation to guide further investigation without being presented as a verified conclusion.
blocks.zh: 对判断的认知性叙述有助于解释这种风险,说明新出现的解释如何影响对个别事实的解释[19、20]。 如果一致性指导着一个代理人的判断,它可能接受一个连接的假设,因为这一假设使叙述内容相互配合。 关于来源监测的研究涉及将外部提供的信息与内部产生的解释加以区分的相关问题[50]。 对于代理人来说,跟踪哪些关系被报告,哪些关系被推断出来,就可以作出可信的解释,指导进一步的调查,而不作为经核实的结论提出。

blocks.en: Apparent consensus from shared evidence
blocks.zh: 共享证据的明显共识

blocks.en: When several agents reach the same conclusion, their agreement may appear to provide independent confirmation even when they rely on the same evidence. In our shared-feed setting, rumour acceptance remained above 50% under both majority voting and judge review, despite the judge’s access to the original material. These errors show why multi-agent systems need to check whether agreeing reports draw on independent evidence [ 34 , 51 ] . Different explanations may still rely on the same unverified connection, leaving the conclusion without additional support. Human studies describe a similar concern, as repeated expressions from one source can create an impression of wider agreement, and social influence can increase confidence without improving collective accuracy [ 16 , 52 ] .
blocks.zh: 当若干代理人得出同一结论时,即使他们依赖同一证据,他们的协议也似可提供独立确认。 尽管法官可以查阅原始材料, 在我们的共同食物环境下, 传言接受率仍然超过50%, 这些错误表明,为什么多代理人系统需要检查商定报告是否利用了独立证据[34、51]。 不同的解释仍然可能依赖于相同的未经验证的连接,使得结论没有额外的支持. 人类研究描述了类似的关切,因为一个来源的反复表达会给人造成更广泛的共识的印象,社会影响可以增加信心,而不会提高集体准确性[16,52].

blocks.en: As reports are summarized and recirculated, their reliance on the same evidence may become harder to recognize. Agreement between reports can become more visible than their common source, allowing an inferred connection to be repeated as a verified conclusion. Systems that pass summaries between agents could record which fragments support a conclusion and which connections an agent has added, helping later agents distinguish repeated interpretation from independent support. This record would also make it possible to trace which conclusions need correction when an underlying premise is challenged.
blocks.zh: 随着报告的总结和重新分发,对同样证据的依赖可能更加难以确认。 报告之间的一致意见比共同来源更加明显,从而可以重复推定的联系,作为经核实的结论。 在代理人之间传递摘要的系统可以记录哪些片段支持一个结论,哪些连接一个代理人所添加,帮助后来的代理人区分重复解释和独立支持. 这一记录还将使人们有可能在对一个基本前提提出质疑时追踪哪些结论需要更正。

blocks.en: Runtime monitoring of evidential support
blocks.zh: 对证据支持的运行时间监测

blocks.en: GM uses salience to assess how strongly a narrative promotes a target and grounding to check whether any individual post directly supports it. Salience distinguished attack montages from chronological reporting, whereas rumour and non-rumour montages generated by the same procedure both strongly promoted their targets. Within this latter comparison, grounding-post counts provided additional information about direct support, as shown in Table 2 . The monitor therefore raises an alarm only when salience reaches its threshold and no grounding post is detected, focusing attention on the gap between promoting a conclusion and directly supporting it. Communicating this assessment while allowing agents to withhold acceptance improved decision accuracy across all four models, as shown in Fig. 5 . The feeds remained unchanged, making this a proof of concept for improving acceptance decisions without removing truthful fragments.
blocks.zh: 全球机制利用突出地位来评估叙述如何大力促进目标并打地基,以检查是否有任何个人员额直接支持目标。 显著之处是攻击蒙塔吉斯与时间顺序报告不同,而同一程序产生的谣言和非流言蒙塔吉斯则有力地促进了目标。 如表2所示,在后一种比较中,基岗计数提供了关于直接支助的补充资料。 因此,监测器只有在显著性达到临界值并且没有探测到地面站时才发出警报,把注意力集中在促进结论与直接支持结论之间的差距上。 如图5所示,在传达这一评估的同时,允许代理人拒绝接受所有四种模型的决定准确性有所提高。 资料没有改变,这就证明了改进接受决定的概念,而不去除真实的碎片。

blocks.en: Extending this approach to conclusions supported by several fragments requires checking how those fragments jointly establish the claim. For illustration, a post reporting eleven deaths, if accurate, establishes that casualty count, whereas inferring a plane’s rapid descent requires comparing altitude readings taken at different times. A monitor would need to verify that the readings refer to the same aircraft and establish the rate of descent before judging whether it supports the description. More generally, an extended GM could identify the premises needed for a conclusion, link each premise to its source fragment and check the intermediate reasoning steps, drawing on work that represents reasoning through explicit evidence chains [ 53 , 54 ] . The aim would be to locate missing or unsupported connections while preserving conclusions that follow from several fragments, even when no single post establishes them.
blocks.zh: 将这种方法扩大到由若干片段支持的结论,需要检查这些片段如何共同证明索赔。 例如,一个报告11人死亡(如果准确的话)的帖子可以确定伤亡人数,而推断飞机的快速下降需要比较不同时间的高度读数。 监测员将需要核实读数是否指同一种飞机,并确定下降率,然后判断它是否支持这一描述。 更一般地说,扩大的全球机制可以确定得出结论所需的前提,将每个前提与其源碎片联系起来,并检查中间推理步骤,利用通过明确的证据链来代表推理的工作[53、54]。 目的是找到缺失或无根据的连接,同时保留几个片段的结论,即使没有单一的帖子确定。

blocks.en: For these checks to be useful, the monitor’s own support judgements must also be open to verification. The classifier could return the relevant text with each relation label, allowing a separate verifier to assess whether that label follows from the fragment or depends on an added assumption. Evaluating support labels and final acceptance decisions separately on both supported and unsupported narratives would help distinguish more accurate support checking from a general tendency to withhold acceptance. Alongside these runtime checks, machine unlearning could be explored as a way to reduce learned influences that encourage unsupported inference [ 55 , 56 ] . Its value for narrative manipulation would depend on identifying which influences to weaken while preserving factual knowledge and the ability to combine evidence correctly.
blocks.zh: 为了使这些检查有用,监测员自己的支持性判断也必须开放供核查。 分类员可以将相关文本与每个关联标签一起返回,允许一个单独的核查员评估该标签是来自碎片还是取决于附加的假设。 对支助标签和关于支助和非支助说明的最后接受决定分别进行评价,将有助于区分更准确的支助核对和拒绝接受的一般趋势。 除了这些运行时间检查之外,还可以探索机器不学习,以减少鼓励无支持推论的已学到的影响[55、56]。 它对叙述性操纵的价值将取决于在保留事实知识和正确综合证据的能力的同时,确定哪些影响会削弱。

blocks.en: Prior knowledge in attack and monitoring evaluation
blocks.zh: 攻击和监测评价的先天知识

blocks.en: From an attack perspective, rumour acceptance remains a consequential failure even if the victim agent is familiar with the event, particularly if it possesses knowledge that could help it challenge the narrative. Real-event settings therefore remain important for assessing the risks to assistants interpreting public events. In the fixed-text controls, replacing entity names produced smaller changes in target belief than changing the narrative generation source, as shown in Extended Data Table Extended Data . Thus, the comparison between ORIG and ANON also reflects changes in the generated narrative, beyond the replacement of familiar names.
blocks.zh: 从攻击的角度来看,即使受害人代理人熟悉事件,特别是如果它掌握了可能有助于对叙述提出质疑的知识,但谣言的接受仍然是一个后果性的失败。 因此,实际活动环境对于评估助理解释公共活动的风险仍然很重要。 在固定文本控制中,替换实体名称在目标信仰上产生的变化比改变叙述生成源要小,如扩展数据表扩展数据所示. 因此,ORIG和ANON的比较也反映了所生成的叙事变化,除了替换熟悉的名字之外.

blocks.en: For monitoring, however, prior knowledge may help an agent reject a familiar rumour or influence how the monitor assesses its support. The additional ANON evaluation therefore tested whether GM remained useful with fewer familiar event cues. In target-only probes, event recognition by GPT-4.1-mini fell from 44.5% to 5.5%, confirming reduced recognizability in the model used for monitoring, as shown in Extended Data Table Extended Data . Although final accuracy was higher in ANON, the evidence for GM’s value comes from comparing decisions between baseline and GM response conditions within each setting, where the feeds remain unchanged. The improvements in both settings, shown in Fig. 5 , indicate that the monitoring benefit extends to regenerated narratives with reduced event recognizability.
blocks.zh: 不过,对于监测,事先知情可能有助于代理人拒绝熟悉的谣言,或影响监测员如何评估其支持。 因此,补充的ANON评价测试了全球机制是否仍然有用,而熟悉的活动提示较少。 如扩展数据表扩展数据所示,在仅目标探测器中,GPT-4.1-mini对事件识别率从44.5%下降到5.5%,证实用于监测的模型的可识别性降低。 虽然最终准确度在ANON中较高,但证明全球机制价值的证据来自将基准条件和全球机制的反应条件在每种情况下进行比较的决定,在这两种情况下,信息源保持不变。 图5显示的两种环境的改善表明,监测的好处扩大到了事件可识别性降低的再生成叙述。

blocks.en: Broader implications
blocks.zh: 更广泛的影响

blocks.en: For information assistants that summarize public events for users, monitoring needs to address the inferences that connect factual reporting to decisions. A social-media summary may preserve every quoted fact yet add a relationship that changes whom users blame, what they believe has happened or which response they consider necessary. The risk therefore concerns how truthful information is organized and given authority, extending responsibility beyond the accuracy of individual statements. Building on methods that link generated claims to their sources [ 57 ] , systems could show users which parts of a summary are directly reported and which depend on an unresolved interpretation. A public warning or decision recommendation would then make clear which assumptions require verification before action is taken.
blocks.zh: 对于为用户总结公共事件的信息助理,监测需要处理将事实报告与决定联系起来的推论。 社会媒体摘要可能保留每一个引用的事实,但会增加一种关系,改变用户的责备、他们认为所发生的情况或他们认为必要的反应。 因此,这种风险涉及真实信息是如何组织和授权的,将责任扩大到个人陈述的准确性之外。 借助将产生的权利要求与其来源联系起来的方法[57],系统可以显示用户直接报告摘要的哪些部分,哪些部分取决于未解决的解释。 然后,公开的警告或决定建议将明确哪些假设需要核查才能采取行动。

blocks.en: When automated support checks flag a conclusion, human oversight could provide a route to verification. An agent’s uncertain response following an alarm could prompt a reviewer to check whether the fragments jointly establish the conclusion or whether independent evidence is needed, with retrieval supporting that investigation [ 58 , 59 ] . Review could prioritize claims that affect important decisions, while helping agents accept supported conclusions when the monitor misses a valid connection across fragments. Studies of human and AI collaboration show that its benefits depend on the task and the roles assigned to each participant [ 60 ] . Evaluation should therefore measure how often reviewers correct unsupported decisions or confirm supported conclusions, alongside the time and workload required.
blocks.zh: 当自动支助检查显示结论时,人的监督可以提供核查的途径。 特工在警报后作出不确定的反应,可能促使审查人员检查碎片是否共同确定结论,或是否需要独立证据,并进行检索,以支持调查[58、59]。 审查可以优先处理影响重要决定的索偿要求,同时当显示器没有在片段之间有效连接时,帮助代理人接受支持的结论。 对人与AI合作的研究表明,这种合作的好处取决于分配给每个参与者的任务和作用[60]. 因此,评价应衡量审查人员在花费所需时间和工作量的同时,如何经常纠正未经支持的决定或确认得到支持的结论。

blocks.en: We study lying with truth by combining behavioural evaluation, fragment-level response analysis and the neuro-symbolic monitor GM. Within this design, narrative overfitting denotes the receiving model’s unsupported synthesis, cognition-based collusion denotes its deliberate exploitation by coordinated producers, and Generative Montage is the procedure used to construct misleading narratives from truthful fragments. This procedure and the CoPHEME benchmark provide a controlled setting for evaluating the threat [ 26 ] . A victim agent is an evaluated model instance interpreting a feed in the analyst role. Target acceptance denotes its recorded endorsement at adjudication, whereas a belief readout quantifies its probability-based response to the target. Supplementary Table 1 summarizes the purpose, material, models and comparisons of each experiment.

blocks.en: Public-event evidence and target propositions

blocks.en: CoPHEME organizes PHEME material collected from Twitter during real public events [ 3 ] around six events: Charlie Hebdo, the Sydney siege, protests in Ferguson, the Ottawa shooting, the Germanwings crash and Vladimir Putin’s disappearance from public view. Its attack split contains 4,950 evidence items and 1,090 rumour targets, with event-level statistics in Supplementary Table 2 . Evidence came from threads labelled true or non-rumour; rumour targets combined false and unverified source labels, and non-rumour controls carried true labels. Gurlitt, Prince Toronto and Ebola Essien were excluded because their pools were too small for the multi-post construction protocol. Historical cascade size was retained as descriptive metadata.
blocks.zh: PHEME组织在Twitter上收集的材料, 查理·赫布多(Charlie Hebdo),悉尼围城事件,弗格森的抗议活动,渥太华枪击事件,日耳曼翼军坠毁事件以及弗拉基米尔·普京从公众视野消失事件. 其攻击分数包括4 950个证据项目和1 090个谣言目标,事件级统计数据载于补充表2。 证据来自标有真假或非鲁木的线条;谣言目标结合了虚假和未经核实的源标签,非鲁木的控制带有真实的标签. 古利特,多伦多亲王和埃博拉·埃西安被排除在外,因为他们的池子太小,不适合多点建造协议. 历史级联规模被保留为描述性元数据。

blocks.en: To construct each feed, the generator received the same-event evidence pool and h ∗ h^{*} . It could select and compose factual material from the admissible evidence pool but could not present the rumour target as an established fact; source items explicitly stating that target were excluded from evidence selection. Analysts initially received only this feed, with source labels, production messages and the attack objective withheld, and saw the target only at the subsequent adjudication stage.
blocks.zh: 为了构建每个种子,发电机收到了同一事件的证据池和h * 。 它可以从可接受的证据库中挑选和编成事实材料,但不能将谣言目标作为既定事实;消息来源项目明确指出该目标被排除在证据选择之外。 分析员最初只收到这种饲料,源头标签,制作信息以及攻击目标被扣,仅在后来的裁判阶段才看到目标.

blocks.en: Generative Montage construction
blocks.zh: 基因蒙太奇建筑

blocks.en: For the 1,090-target behavioural evaluation, GPT-4.1-mini [ 39 ] instantiated the Writer, Editor and Director in two sequential revision loops. In the first loop, the Writer selected from the event pool and composed a narrative that made h ∗ h^{*} plausible without presenting it as verified. The Director checked each fragment against the supplied evidence identifiers, rejected unsupported additions and separately assessed apparent support for the target, returning a natural-language critique for up to five revision rounds. If no draft received approval, the highest-scoring factually admissible draft was retained for audit without being treated as approved.
blocks.zh: 对于1,090目标行为评价,GPT-4.1-mini[39]在两个相继的修改循环中,对编剧,编辑和导演进行了即兴播放. 在第一个循环中, Writer 从活动集合中选择并组成了一个说明, 使得 h * h 的 合理性没有被证实。 司长对照所提供的证据识别资料核对了每一片,拒绝了未经证实的添加,并单独评估了对目标的明显支持,对多达5轮的修订工作提出了自然语言批评。 如果没有草案获得核准,最高得分的实际可接受草案将保留供审计,而不作为核准草案处理。

blocks.en: In the second loop, the Editor divided the draft into short posts and revised their order. Its instructions encouraged temporal adjacency, recurrence of target-relevant details, delayed clarification and placement of disambiguating information after suggestive material. The Director applied the same factual check and a ten-point apparent-support score, requiring at least 7 for approval and allowing at most five Editor revisions. Through this shared rule, the Director coordinated the Writer’s selection and narrative context with the Editor’s fragmentation and ordering, so all three roles optimized the same target-directed construction.
blocks.zh: 在第二圈中,编辑将草稿分为短帖并修改了顺序. 其指示鼓励暂时性、重复与目标有关的细节、拖延澄清和在暗示材料之后放置含糊不清的信息。 司长采用了同样的事实检查和10分明显支持分数,至少需要7分才能获得批准,并允许编辑最多5次修订。 通过这个共同的规则,导演协调了编者的选择和叙事背景与编辑的分散和命令,因此这三个角色都优化了同一个目标导向的构造.

blocks.en: Approved sequences were rendered under distinct simulated publisher identities, retaining order and timestamps without creating live accounts. Analysts saw only the public feed, and any subsequent propagation of the target was recorded as an outcome. In the Charlie Hebdo production audit reported in Extended Data Table Extended Data , first approval occurred after 3.03 ± 0.17 3.03\pm 0.17 Writer rounds and 3.00 ± 0.23 3.00\pm 0.23 Editor rounds, with the best approved candidates occurring later. The response-analysis experiments used the same role structure to generate the feeds evaluated below.

blocks.en: Analyst protocol, model coverage and acceptance metrics
blocks.zh: 分析协议、模型覆盖面和验收指标

blocks.en: Each behavioural evaluation separated open interpretation from target adjudication. First, an analyst saw F F without h ∗ h^{*} and reported its inferred central claim, a true/false judgement on that claim, a rationale and its confidence in that judgement. Once this report was fixed, the analyst was shown h ∗ h^{*} and asked whether the feed supported it; this separately recorded verdict provided the common target endpoint across models. Each target was evaluated in five separately instantiated analyst runs, pairing the initial report’s confidence with the subsequent target verdict.

The 14-model panel comprised five GPT models, GPT-4o-mini, GPT-4o, GPT-4.1-nano, GPT-4.1-mini and GPT-4.1 [ 37 , 38 , 39 ] ; three Claude models, Claude-3-Haiku, Claude-3.5-Haiku and Claude-4.5-Haiku [ 40 , 41 , 42 ] ; Qwen2.5-Instruct 3B, 7B and 14B [ 43 ] ; and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen 1.5B, 7B and 14B [ 44 ] . Names identify the versions used during collection. For brevity, Results refers to the Qwen2.5-Instruct and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models as Qwen2.5 and DeepSeek-R1 followed by their parameter count. Unless otherwise stated for a prompting comparison, analysts used the same direct adjudication format.

blocks.en: The Charlie Hebdo construction ablations retained the target and evidence pool while removing Director feedback, Editor sequencing or role separation. Without feedback, Writer and Editor each produced a single output; without the Editor, the Writer’s draft was rendered without sequence optimization; in the single-agent condition, one prompt combined selection, drafting and post construction. Because prompts and numbers of model calls also differed, these comparisons estimate the contribution of complete procedures.

blocks.en: GM checks the complete feed and specified target before target adjudication. We implement the monitor using a symbolic dependency engine with assumption retraction, adding target-relative neural relation labels and the alarm rule defined below. Given the feed F F and target h ∗ h^{*} , a fixed GPT-4.1-mini classifier provides an external assessment of each post’s relation to the target, assigning one of four labels: grounds , abductive , undermines or irrelevant . A post is labelled grounds when its accuracy would make h ∗ h^{*} necessarily true; preceding posts may resolve references but do not supply additional premises. Posts that promote the target without establishing it are labelled abductive , including when establishing the target would require combining fragments. The labels undermines and irrelevant identify posts that provide evidence against the target or do not bear on it, respectively. blocks.en: This Supplementary Information summarizes the datasets, models, evaluation measures and comparison conditions used in each experiment. It also provides event-level statistics for the CoPHEME dataset, including the numbers of evidence items and rumour targets, together with the mean cascade size of rumours recorded in the source data.
